target_customer: Nigerian households and food businesses buying fresh meat
problem: Buying clean, consistently good meat in Nigeria is slow and unreliable; Sendme took orders through a WhatsApp chatbot and promised delivery within 3 hours.
business_model: On-demand meat retail and delivery with margin on product

founders.name: Daniel Afolayan
education: Medical training, school not named on YC page
previous_startups: An innovation hub and a logistics company, per YC page, names not given
founders.background_notes: YC page says he trained as a medical doctor, then worked as a product manager.

technical_complexity.rationale: A WhatsApp ordering chatbot plus local logistics and cold chain sourcing; the hard part was operations, not software.

defensibility.rationale: Meat sourcing and delivery in Ibadan had no technical moat and the chatbot was easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying it. A 2023 report cited by one aggregator said deliveries were paused temporarily, not verified.

market_need_then: Nigerian consumers and food businesses wanted reliable fresh meat sourcing; sources describe inconsistent quality and time-consuming procurement, from aggregator profiles only.

identity.logo: Plain letter S mark per a directory listing

brand_strength.rationale: Little press about the brand; the name resembles Sendy, Sendbox and others, so it was easily confused.

outcome_analysis: The YC directory lists Sendme as Inactive, but no shutdown report, post-mortem or acquisition was found, so the cause is not public. Aggregators show a small seed raise of about 500K in total across 2022 and 2023 and an unclear operating status. Low defensibility and capital intensive meat logistics are plausible pressures, but no source states why activity stopped.
notes: Website sendme.ng returned HTTP 503 on fetch. Both rounds rest on single aggregators (Startup List for 2022-03 with YC as lead, CB Insights for 2023-02 and total 500K over 3 rounds); amounts unknown. Another aggregator lists 2.3M total, unverified. Founding year conflicts (YC page 2021, aggregators 2020). Exit type unknown: status Inactive but no shutdown evidence. Competitors named by aggregators (Meatify, Meat District) have no dated sources so none listed.
